requirements.quote: Guests can search rooms by date, location and price range.
Guests can cancel a booking free of charge up to 48 hours before check in.
Guests can cancel a booking free of charge up to 24 hours before check in.
The system should provide a great booking experience.
Hotel managers can update room prices and availability.
Confirmation emails must be sent after a successful booking.
The system must be built on the company's existing cloud platform.
Assumption: room rates are quoted in a single currency.
